name: struct-compact
description: Auto-compaction via a slimmed transcript summarized by `claude -p --model haiku` into a structured handoff.

warnEnabled.title: Warn before auto-compaction
warnEnabled.description: Remind the agent to write unsaved notes to disk shortly before auto-compaction runs.

warnPercent.title: Warn at (% of window)
warnPercent.description: How close to the compaction point, as a percent of the compaction window, the reminder is sent.

notesFile.title: Notes file
notesFile.description: Where the reminder suggests the agent writes its notes.

autoCompactPctOverride.title: Auto-compact percent override
autoCompactPctOverride.description: Set to the value of CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE when the reminder cannot see that environment variable. Empty reads the environment.
